description: This file contains implementation of hostapd microcode interface functions, including management of BSS and interface configurations, control commands, and DPP-related functionalities, with integration to a VM-based scripting environment.

methods.name: hostapd_ucode_bss_get_uval
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a ucode value for a given hostapd data instance.

methods.name: hostapd_ucode_update_bss_list
methods.description: Updates the list of BSS in the ucode environment.

methods.name: hostapd_ucode_update_interfaces
methods.description: Updates the interface list in the ucode environment.

methods.name: uc_hostapd_add_iface
methods.description: Adds a new interface via ucode scripting.

methods.name: uc_hostapd_remove_iface
methods.description: Removes an interface via ucode scripting.

methods.name: uc_hostapd_bss_set_config
methods.description: Sets BSS configuration dynamically.

methods.name: uc_hostapd_bss_delete
methods.description: Deletes a BSS instance.

methods.name: uc_hostapd_iface_state
methods.description: Returns the current state of the interface.

methods.name: uc_hostapd_iface_add_bss
methods.description: Adds a BSS to an interface.

methods.name: uc_hostapd_bss_ctrl
methods.description: Sends control commands to a BSS.

methods.name: uc_hostapd_iface_stop
methods.description: Stops an interface.

methods.name: uc_hostapd_iface_start
methods.description: Starts an interface with optional configuration.

methods.name: uc_hostapd_iface_switch_channel
methods.description: Switches the channel of an interface.

methods.name: uc_hostapd_bss_rename
methods.description: Renames a BSS interface.

methods.name: hostapd_ucode_sta_auth
methods.description: Handles station authentication via ucode.

methods.name: hostapd_ucode_sta_connected
methods.description: Handles station connection event via ucode.

methods.name: uc_wpa_rkh_derive_key
methods.description: Derives a key for WPA RKH.

methods.name: uc_hostapd_bss_dpp_send_action
methods.description: Sends a DPP action frame.

methods.name: uc_hostapd_bss_dpp_send_gas_resp
methods.description: Sends a DPP GAS response.

methods.name: hostapd_ucode_dpp_rx_action
methods.description: Processes received DPP action frames.

methods.name: hostapd_ucode_dpp_gas_req
methods.description: Creates a DPP GAS request.

methods.name: hostapd_ucode_wps_m7_rx
methods.description: Handles WPS M7 reception.
